note: Pinned copies of the live shadcn registry schemas, vendored so the conformance gate is deterministic and needs no network. The gate validates dist/registry/ against THESE bytes; registry-drift.mjs (manual, non-blocking) re-fetches and reports when upstream has moved.

registry.json.includeDescription: An array of relative paths to registry.json files to include in this registry.

notes.registryDependencies: PRESENT in the live schema (array of strings). The review retracted it as item-links-only; the fetched bytes contradict that retraction, so the field exists and is simply not used here.
notes.cssVars: item-level (tailwind.cssVars is not the path the research note claimed).
notes.extends: available for registry:style items only — which is what a CSS-only bundle item is.
